next_action.rationale: Two approval-gated mitigations (apply_slot_correction, then replay_held_allocations) have now been applied on the strength of C8. Neither the gate approval nor the driver's acknowledgement confirms real-world efficacy -- approval only means the action was authorized, not that it resolved the stuck cohort. Before declaring the incident closed or citing an unverified impact figure, a read-only count of currently stranded orders is needed to confirm whether EXC-0921 orders actually cleared 'allocated, awaiting pickup', or whether the mismatch persists and C8 needs to be revised/split.
next_action.expected_information_gain: Confirms or refutes that the mitigations actually resolved the stuck cohort: a count near zero corroborates C8 as sufficient root cause and closes the loop; a count that remains near 186 would contradict the sufficiency of C8's fix and require re-opening the investigation (e.g., a second mechanism, or the correction/replay not covering the full cohort) before final_assessment.
